title: Jim Harbaugh: Broncos took advantage of a loophole the NFL should not allow

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jim Harbaugh: Broncos took advantage of a loophole the NFL should not allow
sources.description: The Chargers' head coach is not happy with the Broncos trying to renegotiate the trade for Daiyan Henley after the deadline, or with the NFL allowing it.
